subject: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finvera.com>; Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finvera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I’ve pulled together a short mutual action sprint (MAP) to land the evaluation and get a realistic close window on production feasibility. I want to introduce the technical owners on our side so we can sync on scope and timelines quickly:

- Rishi Malhotra — Solutions Engineer, will lead runtime and integration touchpoints (endpoints, auth, network).
- Marcus Lin — ML Engineer, will lead model selection, quantization/accuracy tradeoffs, and eval metrics.
- Priyom Das — Customer Success (scoping & rollout milestones).

Lena, would you confirm who from Finvera will be the day-to-day engineering lead and the person we should route technical questions to?

Short plan (attached: Finvera_MAP_v0.3.xlsx):
- Week 0 (this week): align technical owners, share dataset sample and schema
- Week 1: baseline eval runs + integration checklist
- Week 2: perf/cost tuning, MAP checkpoint, decision node for pilot

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical kickoff sometime this week or early next week. Rishi & Marcus are mostly available Tue/Wed mornings (PST). Can you share a 2-hour window that works for your engineering lead?

Attachments: Finvera_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP workbook), dataset_schema_sample.csv (small sample)

Thanks — happy to iterate the MAP once we confirm stakeholders.

— Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@finvera.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finvera.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline

Thanks Ava —

Appreciate the clear outline. I’ll be the primary engineering contact for the MAP and will loop in Tom for infra/security items. A quick intro from our side:

- Lena Ortiz — Staff Engineering Lead, Finvera (primary engineering lead for integrations)
- Tom Hsu — Principal Infrastructure Engineer (network/infra/security lead)

We’ve reviewed the MAP workbook and the dataset sample looks representative. A couple quick things up front:
- Dataset size: full training/eval dataset ~180GB (S3). We’ll provide sampled partitions for early runs.
- Security: we need a short list of required security artifacts (SOC2 scope, temp creds lifecycle) to share with InfoSec.

Time: Tue Dec 1, 10:30–11:30am PT works for us. If that’s tight, Wed Dec 2 morning is also possible.

I’ll add a calendar invite once we confirm — looking forward to aligning owners.

— Lena
Lena Ortiz
Staff Engineering Lead, Finvera
lena@finvera.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finvera.com>; Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finvera.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline

Hi Lena — great to meet you (virtually). A few notes so we can make the kickoff efficient: 

1) For the initial eval runs we’ll need:
   - S3 path to the sample partition and an IAM role or pre-signed URLs (short lived)
   - Example inference payloads (typical prompt templates, size distribution)

2) Network & auth:
   - Do you prefer PrivateLink/VPC peering (we support VPC Private Endpoints for Redwood Private) or using short-lived API keys over the public API (we can proxy through a NAT/whitelist)?

3) Baseline metrics:
   - Marcus and I will propose a neutral baseline set (latency P50/P95, token cost per response, relevance F1 / recall on eval set). If you have internal metrics to match, please share.

I’ll attach a 1-page integration checklist to the invite so the kickoff has clear owners. If you prefer Tue 10:30am PT I’m on that — adding suggested agenda below.

Proposed 60-minute kickoff agenda:
- Intros & roles (5m)
- MAP timeline & success criteria (10m)
- Dataset & infra handoff (15m)
- Baseline eval plan + metrics (15m)
- Next steps & owners (15m)

See you Tue — Rishi

Attachment: integration_checklist_onepager.pdf (stub)

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finvera.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>; Lena Ortiz <lena@finvera.com>; Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 07:45, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Lena — great to meet you (virtually). A few notes so we can make the kickoff efficient: 
> 
> 1) For the initial eval runs we’ll need:
>    - S3 path to the sample partition and an IAM role or pre-signed URLs (short lived)
>    - Example inference payloads (typical prompt templates, size distribution)

Thanks Rishi — that level of detail is perfect. Quick answers:
- We can provide a pre-signed S3 URL set for the sample partitions. I’ll send them to the invite attendees and the role you give me to scope.
- Finvera uses Okta + SCIM for identity; for the purposes of the eval we prefer pre-signed URLs and short-lived API keys. For production we’ll evaluate PrivateLink.

Two asks from our side for the kickoff:
1) A short writeup of what data (headers/PII) will touch Redwood systems and any redaction options.
2) The integration checklist Rishi mentioned so our security reviewer can pre-check before the meeting.

I’ll accept the 10:30am PT slot and will send the calendar invite with dial-in + a link to the sample S3 files.

— Tom
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Finvera
thsu@finvera.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finvera.com>; Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@finvera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — Finvera technical owners & timeline

Perfect — thanks everyone. I’ve updated the MAP workbook with the kickoff time and a short owner column (see attachment). Short action items before the kickoff:

- Finvera (Tom): share pre-signed S3 URLs and a short note on PII/data categories — will route to our security reviewer.
- Finvera (Lena): confirm any hard constraints for latency or throughput we should prioritize.
- Redwood (Rishi + Marcus): draft baseline eval config + one-pager integration checklist (we’ll attach to the invite).
- Redwood (Priyom): finalize MAP milestones and update the workbook with target dates for pilot decision node.

I’ve attached the updated Finvera_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (sheet: owners_and_timing) and the dataset_schema_sample.csv. Will see you on Tue 10:30am PT.

Thanks — Ava
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
